summary: Agent Builder v0.4.1 is accepted but untagged. Define is open with v0.5.0 as a working target. The author confirmed an outcome of lean, understandable, behavior-tested Build increments and asked that Review offer an independent code review for very large changes, with Erico's agent as a Two River Bio candidate. The large-change signal and success evidence remain open. No phase transition, tag, or push was requested.

decisions.summary: Build only what is needed; state the smallest version and exclusions.
Suggestions stay outside scope and proposed decisions expire at phase close.
Consequential approvals are typed in the author's words.
Release 0.2.1 during Review with the first feedback incorporated.
Accept v0.2.1, close Review, carry F-018 through F-025 as inputs, and open the next Define with version and scope undecided.
Formalize project mode and governance for logical versioning, reuse, modularity, and simplicity while constraining Agent Builder to what users need.
Deliver one usable neutral project mode with required build-or-adopt, version-sized MVP, modular reuse, and evidence-backed technical-quality behavior.
Require a DepMap-like adopt-and-archive scenario plus concrete user feedback on cycle time, evidence-backed reuse, or simplification.
Keep project memory structured for agents while making human-facing governance plain, descriptive, and proportional to real consequences.
Validate that real users understand status, decisions, and next action without decoding internal labels, and find approvals consequential and the process lightweight.
Target Agent Builder v0.3.0, version project deliverables independently, and archive no-build adoptions without inventing a project release.
Close Define and enter Plan for v0.3.0.

Confirmed release split: lean v0.3.0 without Spec Kit dependency or source copy, then separately define v0.4.0 with a maintained Spec Kit dependency and targeted replacements; no Windows-specific gate.
Close Plan and enter Build for the confirmed lean v0.3.0 plan.
Close Build and enter Review for v0.3.0; acceptance and tagging remain open.
Accept and locally tag v0.3.0; use it before opening v0.4.0 Define.
Close v0.3.0 Review and open v0.4.0 Define with scope and success evidence still open.
Use Spec Kit only for a demonstrated net improvement; preserve Agent Builder's working core and separately evaluate user-experience changes.
Target Claude Code and Codex across agent, project, and skill builds; exclude Chat, Cowork, and claude.ai from v0.4.0.
Close v0.4.0 Define and open Plan for the approved scope.
Use a pinned Spec Kit CLI at release time to generate and bundle selected upstream assets; do not require a separate member CLI installation.
Use a filtered Spec Kit v1.1.0 payload as non-discoverable Agent Builder data with explicit argument binding, artifact checks, and one owner per record.
Make authenticated Claude Code and Codex handoff a first Build-slice stop/go gate; return to Plan if either fails.
Close v0.4.0 Plan and open Build for the approved scoped integration, beginning with the live-host gate.
Close v0.4.0 Build and open Review; acceptance and tagging remain open.
Accept v0.4.0 for organization use, close Review, publish the tag, and defer the next Define iteration while members use the release.
Open Define for the next minor cycle, tentatively v0.5.0, without assuming scope from prior Review findings.
Narrow the cycle to a v0.4.1 Windows checkout/hash patch, close Define, and enter Plan; Build remains unapproved.
Close v0.4.1 Plan and enter Build for the narrow Git attributes, tests, and patch-version metadata.
Close v0.4.1 Build and enter Review; actual Windows CI and acceptance remain pending, with no push or tag authorized.
Author authorized pushing the v0.4.1 candidate to main for actual Windows CI; all four jobs passed, but acceptance and tag remain pending.
Accept v0.4.1 with passing CI and documented Windows workstation-use limit, close Review, and open Define with v0.5.0 as a working target and scope undecided; do not infer tag or push authorization.
Define lean, understandable, behavior-tested Build increments and offer independent review during Review for very large changes; do not run it automatically or require Erico's tool universally.

next_action: Agree on success evidence and a proportionate signal for very large changes. Remain in Define until the author explicitly authorizes Plan. Only create or push the v0.4.1 tag if separately authorized.
